title: Progress Dashboard Explorer
description: Filter a badge-completion dashboard by cohort and watch the bottleneck move -- with initials only, no names anywhere.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Student Data and Managing Club Communication

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given filter controls, the learner examines a dashboard to identify which badge is currently the biggest bottleneck for a cohort.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Two dropdowns filter and sort; a derived readout names the current bottleneck
pedagogical.assessment: Ask why the two cohorts have different bottlenecks and what that implies about the sessions.
